summary: Phase F11.K — Rule-First, AI-Fallback for Smart Paste — VERIFIED. Created 10 pytest cases covering /smart-paste/parse and /smart-paste/check-duplicate. All 10 passed. Manual curl confirmation: (a) fully-labeled paste returns ai.source='regex', ai.used=false, reason='All mandatory fields extracted via regex — AI skipped.' — LLM not called, zero AI credits consumed. (b) Unstructured/messy WhatsApp paste falls through to LLM (ai.source='llm', ai.used=true). (c) Partial paste missing pincode also invokes LLM (regex short-circuit correctly NOT triggered). (d) use_ai=false payload skips LLM regardless. (e) check-duplicate mirrors the same behaviour. (f) Auth guard preserved — 403 without Bearer token. Response shape on regex path still contains full fields + confidence + warnings + duplicates + ai blocks.
critical_code_review_comments: smart_paste.py:145 — the `if regex_complete or payload.use_ai is False:` branch is defensive and correct. However, when use_ai=false AND regex_complete=false, the reason field stays empty (only regex_complete populates the 'AI skipped' reason). Consider adding a distinct reason like 'AI disabled by caller' for observability.
smart_paste.py:154 — `if payload.use_ai is not False:` is dead code since the outer if already short-circuits when use_ai is False. Safe to simplify but not urgent.

smart_paste.py:238 — check-duplicate honours settings.smart_paste_ai_enabled while parse (line 154) does NOT check that flag; parse only skips LLM on regex-complete or explicit use_ai=false. Inconsistent — parse could also respect smart_paste_ai_enabled for a per-user global kill switch. Not a bug for this phase but worth flagging.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Env var used: EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL (from frontend/.env). Fallback to EXPO_BACKEND_URL supported in test file. Run: `cd /app && EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL=<url> pytest backend/tests/test_phase_f11k_smart_paste_rule_first.py -v`. Regex short-circuit reason string is exactly 'All mandatory fields extracted via regex — AI skipped.' (em-dash, not hyphen).
